finalText:
Both the test runner and the independent verifier are green.

The bug: in `orderTotal` (`src/pricing.js`), tax was calculated on the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted amount, even though the order was supposed to be discount-then-tax. Fixed by taxing `discounted` instead of `cents`. No other files were touched — `cases.js`, `run-tests.js`, and `tiers.js` were all already correct.
